task: Write a Python function find_configs(root) that returns all .toml files under the given root directory, recursively.

constraints.text: filesystem paths go through pathlib.Path; os.path string manipulation stays out of new code
constraints.why: os.path string handling broke on Windows UNC paths during the February migration

constraints.text: recursive directory traversal uses Path.rglob rather than os.walk
constraints.why: hand-rolled os.walk traversal missed symlinked config directories in the February migration
